meta.note: Snapshot of the sample dataset produced by js/demo-data.js. The app seeds localStorage from the generator (dates stay relative to the day of seeding and it also works without fetch); this JSON is a reference/backup copy that can be imported from Settings > Demo Data.

complaints.subject: Food too spicy at dinner
complaints.description: Dinner curries have been very spicy this week.

complaints.subject: Bathroom not cleaned
complaints.description: Common bathroom on 2nd floor was not cleaned for two days.

complaints.subject: Slow Wi-Fi in evenings
complaints.description: Internet speed drops below 1 Mbps after 8 PM.

complaints.subject: Window does not close
complaints.description: Window latch is broken; rain water enters.

complaints.subject: Loud music late night
complaints.description: Room next door plays music after 11 PM.

complaints.subject: Breakfast served late
complaints.description: Breakfast started at 8 AM instead of 7 AM.

complaints.subject: Fan making noise
complaints.description: Ceiling fan is wobbling and noisy.

complaints.subject: Rude behaviour at gate
complaints.description: Security staff was rude when I returned at 9 PM.

complaints.subject: Garbage not collected
complaints.description: Dustbin in corridor overflowing.

complaints.subject: Request more veg options
complaints.description: Please add more vegetarian dishes for lunch.

complaints.subject: Bed bugs
complaints.description: Bed bugs found in mattress — need pest control.

complaints.subject: Wi-Fi password not working
complaints.description: Unable to connect after password change.

complaints.subject: No hot water
complaints.description: Geyser on 1st floor not working.

complaints.subject: Laundry clothes missing
complaints.description: Two shirts missing from last laundry batch.

complaints.subject: Drinking water taste
complaints.description: Water from purifier tastes odd.

complaints.subject: Construction noise
complaints.description: Renovation noise during exam week.

complaints.subject: Mess hall tables sticky
complaints.description: Tables are not wiped between batches.

complaints.subject: Locker key lost
complaints.description: Need duplicate locker key.

complaints.subject: Cook unavailable on Sunday
complaints.description: Dinner was delayed due to staff absence.

complaints.subject: Leaking pipe under sink
complaints.description: Water pooling below wash basin.

complaints.subject: LAN port dead
complaints.description: Ethernet port in room not working.

complaints.subject: Egg not provided
complaints.description: Egg curry missing from Tuesday menu.

complaints.subject: Parking space for bicycle
complaints.description: Request covered parking for cycles.

complaints.subject: Mosquito problem
complaints.description: Need mosquito nets or fogging.

complaints.subject: Curtain rod fell
complaints.description: Curtain rod detached from wall.

complaints.subject: Dinner portion size
complaints.description: Chapathi count reduced to 3.

notices.title: Hostel fee due reminder
notices.message: Monthly hostel and mess fees are due on or before the 10th. A late fee applies after the due date.

notices.title: Water supply interruption
notices.message: Water supply will be interrupted on Saturday from 10 AM to 2 PM due to tank cleaning.

notices.title: Onam celebration
notices.message: Join us for Onam Sadya and cultural programmes in the mess hall. Traditional dress encouraged!

notices.title: New mess menu from Monday
notices.message: The revised weekly menu is now live. Share feedback with the mess manager.

notices.title: Gate timings revised
notices.message: Main gate closes at 10:00 PM. Late entry requires prior approval from the warden.

notices.title: Fire drill
notices.message: A mandatory fire drill will be conducted. Assemble at the front lawn when the alarm sounds.

notices.title: Staff meeting
notices.message: Monthly staff meeting in the admin office at 4 PM.

notices.title: Wi-Fi upgrade
notices.message: Internet upgrade to 300 Mbps fibre is scheduled next week.

notices.title: Room inspection
notices.message: Wardens will conduct a routine room inspection this weekend.

notices.title: Independence Day programme
notices.message: Flag hoisting at 8 AM followed by breakfast.
